module.name: ibm_roks_cluster_install_cert_manager
module.description: Install cert-manager into an existing IBM ROKS cluster, using credentials from the IBM Cloud Credential Template.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to fetch cluster credentials.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID where cert-manager will be installed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: wait_for_deployment
optional.description: Wait for cert-manager pods to become ready before returning.

optional.name: timeout
optional.description: Timeout (seconds) for the cert-manager Helm release.

optional.name: post_deployment_delay
optional.description: Delay (seconds) after the Helm release to let CRDs register before downstream modules use them.

key_outputs.name: helm_release_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the cert-manager Helm release.

key_outputs.name: crd_ready
key_outputs.description: True once cert-manager CRDs are expected to be registered.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
